## Name

What should the template be called? (kebab-case, English)

## Inspiration

Link or reference: (e.g., a real color palette, a famous website, an existing platform)

## Required fields

If you're proposing the template's contents, fill out:

```yaml
# Example YAML for your template
id: your-template-id
name: "Human-readable name"
category: category/subcategory
version: "1.0.0"
tags: [tag1, tag2]
```

## Use case

When would a user pick this template over the existing ones?

## Preview

If you have a mockup, screenshot, or hex-color list, attach it here.
